content: Claude Code CLI 2.1.220 headless: -p supports --output-format text|json|stream-json (stream-json requires --verbose). Final line is a result envelope with subtype (success|error_max_turns|error_during_execution), is_error, session_id, num_turns, terminal_reason (completed|aborted_tools), permission_denials[], total_cost_usd, result. Session continuation via --continue (most recent in cwd), --resume <session_id>, --session-id <uuid> (caller-chosen), --fork-session. Session lookup scoped to cwd + git worktrees. SIGTERM aborts turn, kills Bash process tree, runs SessionEnd hooks, exits 143. Permission modes: default/manual, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions. --bare skips OAuth/keychain and REQUIRES ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, so it is incompatible with subscription auth. Empirically: text-only runs exit ~2s clean (exit 0); tool-using runs hung indefinitely (duration_api_ms ~2s but duration_ms == wall-clock timeout) due to user PreToolUse hooks with no timeout blocking on the critical path. --max-turns works but is absent from --help.
